mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops falling and turns up from its current low base, commuting-linked purchases will recover with a lag and push RETAIL_REC above the last-four-week average over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved from -8.0 to 2.3 across the last two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains at or below the prior 4-week mean for the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES averages above 0 and rises week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A further decline in TRANSIT below its recent level reduces spontaneous shopping trips and footfall, which lowers RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -12 on a weekly mean and stays there for 2 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -11.4 in t-1w and -10.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above the prior 4-week mean after TRANSIT remains below -12 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both weaken together, errand chaining and transfer traffic into shopping districts shrink, causing RETAIL_REC to fall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from 12.9 to 7.1 while TRANSIT stayed negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT remaining below their t-3w levels.

mechanism_narrative: Deepening PARKS weakness signals poor outdoor demand and fewer leisure outings, which then drags retail-and-recreation mobility lower within the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -40 and does not rebound for 1 week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -35.1 to -43.6 across the snapshot window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after PARKS drops below -40.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES remains muted, people substitute toward home-based routines and discretionary trips ease, pushing RETAIL_REC down over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive near 6-8 while WORKPLACES was near or below zero in recent weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next month while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5 and WORKPLACES remains at or below 0.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run improvement in GROCERY_PHARM captures errand consolidation that spills into adjacent retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 2 points week-on-week after being above 5
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined from 12.9 to 7.1 but remained positive
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM posts a week-on-week gain of at least 2 points from a level above 5.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in WORKPLACES only matters when TRANSIT is also improving; together they restore commuter flows and raise RETAIL_REC over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded to 2.3 while TRANSIT remained around -10.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both trending upward for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When every non-home movement proxy stays depressed at once, the local activity regime is restrictive enough that retail mobility keeps weakening over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -10 and WORKPLACES at or below 0 and PARKS below -40 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS reached -43.6 while TRANSIT was -10.0 and WORKPLACES was 2.3 in the latest week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT stays below -10, WORKPLACES stays at or below 0, and PARKS stays below -40.
